out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling tiles above the soft drink pump in dry storage not maintained in good repair. Observed warped and broken ceiling tiles.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please repair or replace ceiling tiles and ensure all junctures are sealed by next routine inspection.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: 1 dr raw prep at 55F.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC placed eggs in walk in cooler to be cooled.

violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1 dr raw prep (55F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F.
